worldcombat.skill.shadowclaw.summary: A shadow slides along the ground to behind the target, and a claw reaches back out of it to rake the weak point from the side it cannot guard: contact damage, a shadow mark left at the hit. When the target is not currently watching you, the claw lands heavier; it has the family's raised critical chance.
worldcombat.skill.shadowclaw.description: The claw deals about %1$s contact damage to a single target and lands critical hits more often.
The shadow first reaches a target %1$s blocks away.
When the target is not watching you, the claw's damage is increased by %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowclaw.deep.on: Deep form: the claw is heavier and the ambush bonus is higher, at longer preparation and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shadowclaw.deep.off: Close form: a faster draw and a shorter cooldown, at lower power and ambush bonus.
worldcombat.skill.shadowclaw.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shadowclaw.growth.0: From level %1$s the claw rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowclaw.growth.1: From level %1$s the ambush bonus rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowclaw.use.0: The shadow slips behind the target and reaches out
worldcombat.skill.shadowclaw.use.1: Heavier when the target is not watching
worldcombat.skill.shadowclaw.use.2: The family's raised critical chance leaves a rake scar
On: 112% power, 0.6 further shadow, 0.1 more ambush bonus and 1 tick longer return delay, at +3 preparation and +8 cooldown. Off: a faster draw, a 0.12 wider rake, a 1 tick quicker return and a shorter cooldown, at 94% power.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of reaching out. Larger values open from further away.
On: when the target is not watching and is attacking somebody else, it strikes first with the full ambush bonus. Off: it ranks the claw as an ordinary mid-range strike.
